title: Nashville Haven • Luxury Skyline Views
description:
Your Nashville adventure starts at this brand-new home, just 2 miles from Broadway's honky-tonks, bars, and live music scene. With multiple private bedrooms, there's plenty of room for family, friends, or a larger group to spread out and unwind.

The space
The rooftop is the real showstopper — one of the best skyline views in the city, perfect for winding down after a day exploring. From there, you're minutes from Nashville's top attractions, dining, and nightlife.

Whatever brings you to town, this home makes for an unforgettable Music City stay.

HOME LAYOUT:
• 4 Floor Unit - complex with an elevator for easy access.
• Open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area
• Level 1 - Garage and Front Entry
• Bedroom 1: Queen over Queen bunk bed with attached bathroom
• Bedroom 2: Queen bed with attached bathroom
• Bedroom 3: King bed with attached bathroom
• Half bathroom located in level 2

About Us:
At King Rentals, we’re committed to making your stay as comfortable, easy, and enjoyable as possible. As a locally owned and operated business, our friendly team is available 24/7 to help with any questions or needs during your stay. We’re here to help you relax, enjoy your time together, and create wonderful memories with your family and friends.

Key Features:
• Fully stocked kitchen with bar seating
• Spacious living room
• Washer and dryer
• Smart TVs and Wi-Fi
• 2-car garage parking
• Private rooftop with stunning skyline views
• Keurig coffee maker (K-Cups only)
• Pack ’n Play available upon request—please let us know in advance if needed.

Location:
Here are some nearby places of interest:
• Musicians Hall of Fame and Museum - 5 mins drive (1.2 miles)
• Tennessee State Museum - 2 mins drive (0.7 mile)
• Nashville Farmers' Market - 3 mins drive (0.9 mile)
• Le Petit Chef - Nashville - 5 mins drive (1.4 miles)
• 5th & Taylor - 4 mins drive (1.2 miles)

Please make sure you navigate to the correct address—1007 B 12th Ave North, not South. Some GPS apps may direct you to the wrong location, so please double-check the address before arrival.

Guest access
Guest access:
• Access codes will be provided for self-check-in.
• This four-level home requires stairs for access.
• You'll have full access to the entire home!

Other things to note
IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ BEFORE BOOKING:
• Maximum Occupancy: Maximum of 8 guests, including adults, children, and infants. No additional guests are permitted due to fire safety and insurance requirements.
• Age Requirement: All guests must be 18 or older, except children staying with their parents or guardians.
• No Parties: Parties and unauthorized gatherings are strictly prohibited. Noise complaints or law enforcement calls may result in immediate termination of the stay without a refund.
• No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited.
• No Pets: This property has a strict no-pet policy.
• Check-In/Check-Out: Check-in is at 3:00 PM and check-out is at 10:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out may be available for an additional fee starting at $60. Please message us in advance to check availability.
• Cancellations & Travel Insurance: We highly recommend purchasing travel insurance for protection against unexpected cancellations, weather, natural disasters, power outages, and other unforeseen events. We’re unable to offer refunds or rescheduled stays outside Airbnb’s Extenuating Circumstances Policy.
• Starter Supplies: We provide a starter supply of essential items. Please bring your personal toiletries and plan to purchase additional supplies if needed.
• Trash: At checkout, kindly take out the trash and place it in the cans near the garage or in the dumpster.
• Stay Connected: Follow us at @kingrentalspropertymgmt for updates.
